michael.name: Michael
michael.domain: Archangel of protection, courage, and inner strength. Leader of the heavenly host, he helps you stand in your truth and move forward fearlessly.
michael.description: Your Life Path 1 places you under the protection of Michael. Guide of pioneers and those who initiate, he supports you in every new beginning and gives you the courage to forge your own path, even alone. His presence reminds you that you have the strength to lead the way.
michael.invocation: Archangel Michael, give me the courage to dare and the strength to stay true to myself in every new beginning.

chamuel.name: Chamuel
chamuel.domain: Archangel of unconditional love, relationships, and inner peace.
chamuel.description: Your Life Path 2 places you under the protection of Chamuel. Guardian of sensitive souls and bridge-builders, he accompanies your search for harmony and sincere connection with others. His presence helps you trust, cooperate, and cultivate peace, starting with your own.
chamuel.invocation: Archangel Chamuel, help me build sincere bonds and cultivate peace, within me and around me.

gabriel.name: Gabriel
gabriel.domain: Messenger archangel, linked to communication, creative inspiration, and the arts. He helps you express your truth with clarity.
gabriel.description: Your Life Path 3 places you under the protection of Gabriel. The messenger par excellence, he supports you in expressing your creativity and helps you turn your ideas into words, works, or shared projects. His presence frees your joy of creating and your need for full self-expression.
gabriel.invocation: Archangel Gabriel, inspire my words and my creations. Help me express my truth with joy and clarity.

uriel.name: Uriel
uriel.domain: Archangel of practical wisdom and inner light. He offers concrete solutions and lasting stability.
uriel.description: Your Life Path 4 places you under the protection of Uriel, whose name means 'Light of God'. He accompanies you in building solid foundations — material and inner — and lights your way when the work feels long or thankless. His presence reminds you that every patient effort bears fruit.
uriel.invocation: Archangel Uriel, light my path and give me the patience to build solid, lasting foundations.

ariel.name: Ariel
ariel.domain: Archangel linked to nature, adventure, and the freedom to be fully yourself. Her name means 'Lioness of God'.
ariel.description: Your Life Path 5 places you under the protection of Ariel. She supports your need for movement, discovery, and change, and helps you live your experiences without fear of the unknown. Her presence reminds you that true freedom goes hand in hand with trust.
ariel.invocation: Archangel Ariel, accompany me through change and give me the confidence to explore my life freely.

raphael.name: Raphael
raphael.domain: Archangel of physical, emotional, and spiritual healing. He watches over homes, families, and healers.
raphael.description: Your Life Path 6 places you under the protection of Raphael, whose name means 'God heals'. He accompanies your calling of love and care for others, while reminding you of the importance of healing yourself too. His presence soothes homes and heals broken bonds.
raphael.invocation: Archangel Raphael, wrap my home and loved ones in your healing light, and help me care for myself as much as I care for others.

jophiel.name: Jophiel
jophiel.domain: Archangel of beauty, mental clarity, and inner wisdom. He illuminates the mind and invites contemplation.
jophiel.description: Your Life Path 7 places you under the protection of Jophiel, whose name means 'Beauty of God'. He accompanies your search for truth and deep understanding, and helps you find beauty and meaning even in silence and solitude. His presence lights up your introspection.
jophiel.invocation: Archangel Jophiel, illuminate my search for wisdom and help me find beauty in silence and introspection.

raguel.name: Raguel
raguel.domain: Archangel of justice, harmony, and order. Known as the 'Friend of God', he ensures relationships and affairs stay fair.
raguel.description: Your Life Path 8 places you under the protection of Raguel. He accompanies your relationship with power, success, and abundance, reminding you that true power is built through integrity and fairness. His presence restores harmony when material stakes take over.
raguel.invocation: Archangel Raguel, help me exercise my power with fairness and keep harmony at the heart of my success.

jeremiel.name: Jeremiel
jeremiel.domain: Archangel of life review and spiritual transformation. He helps take stock with compassion before a new cycle begins.
jeremiel.description: Your Life Path 9 places you under the protection of Jeremiel. He accompanies your mission of completion and service, helping you look at the road you've traveled with compassion rather than judgment. His presence supports the art of letting go so a new cycle can be born.
jeremiel.invocation: Archangel Jeremiel, help me welcome what I have accomplished with gratitude and let go gently.

haniel.name: Haniel
haniel.domain: Archangel of grace, intuition, and spiritual illumination. She is linked to lunar energy and unseen wisdom.
haniel.description: Your Life Path 11, a master number, places you under the protection of Haniel, whose name means 'Grace of God'. She accompanies your heightened sensitivity and your role as an inspiring presence, helping you turn your intuition into clear guidance rather than a burden. Her presence soothes and illuminates at once.
haniel.invocation: Archangel Haniel, awaken my intuition and help me carry my sensitivity as a gift rather than a weight.

sandalphon.name: Sandalphon
sandalphon.domain: Archangel of earthly grounding and manifestation. He carries humanity's prayers to the divine and helps build the concrete.
sandalphon.description: Your Life Path 22, a master number, places you under the protection of Sandalphon. He accompanies your rare ability to turn an immense vision into a concrete, lasting achievement, while keeping your feet on the ground. His presence helps you not get lost in the scale of your own potential.
sandalphon.invocation: Archangel Sandalphon, help me ground my visions in the concrete and build, stone by stone, what is meant to last.

metatron.name: Metatron
metatron.domain: Considered the highest of the archangels, celestial scribe and teacher of mysteries. He guides souls of very high vibration.
metatron.description: Your Life Path 33, the rarest master number, places you under the protection of Metatron. He accompanies your calling to teach and to serve unconditionally, helping you transmit your wisdom with humility despite the intensity of your mission. His presence supports souls carrying a high spiritual responsibility.
metatron.invocation: Archangel Metatron, help me carry my mission with humility and share my light without exhausting myself.
